title: Juicy German Blueberry Cobbler
description: A traditional German dessert featuring fresh blueberries and a crumbly crust, perfect for any occasion. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is easy to make and serves as a great alternative to classic cobblers.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and cinnamon.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender to work it into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish and bake for 40 minutes.
Remove the cobbler from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
